name: Cherokee Natural Gas Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not an existing row: roster has no Xcel or Public Service Company of Colorado line, and P0359 Cheyenne Connector is a different pipe. Passes the threshold. The sponsor is Public Service Company of Colorado, a subsidiary of Xcel Energy. The line runs from Fort Lupton in Weld County to Cherokee Station near Commerce City. It opened in October 2014 and is 34 miles, which is above the 25 km minimum. A KUNC story from October 2014 and a BizWest story both describe the pipeline, and a law firm note from December 2014 covers the right of way. BizWest gives the cost as $110 million. The EIA August 2026 project table, historical projects sheet row 776, lists it as Cherokee Natural Gas Pipeline Project, an intrastate lateral, completed 16 October 2014, 34 miles, 24 inch, 189 MMcf/d added capacity, no federal docket. The 24 inch diameter and 189 MMcf/d capacity come only from the EIA August 2026 table, so they are not staged as values until a verified web reference is added. Intrastate, so no FERC filing is expected. No official route data was found, so route is left as no route. The Parent column was left blank because the Xcel Energy entity spelling was only a fuzzy match.
